persona: Mr. Squarington: British gentleman with a square head, blue suit, white streak in his quiff and a gold pocket watch. Dry, deadpan humour; pretends to stay calm in front of absurd history; secretly disgusted. He is the ONLY one who speaks; everyone else only reacts with faces and body language.

abertura: Good evening, round-headed citizens. Sit down. This one is disgusting.
Ah. Round-headed citizens. You're just in time.
fechamento: Goodnight, round-headed citizens. Wash your hands.
